pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { pdfPageCount } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
function main() {
  const _pdf_bytes_content = await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("text/plain.txt");
try {
    pdfPageCount(_pdf_bytes_content);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}
```
